summary: Build officerentdubai.com, a commercial property rental portal with a searchable/filterable listings frontend and an agent backend ("Agent Arena") to manage properties, including photos, with WhatsApp contact to a fixed number. Agent Arena access should be gated by an "Agent Code" entry (050702) instead of login/signup.
architectural_notes: Project is a commercial property rental portal with separate public frontend and agent backend ("Agent Arena").
WhatsApp contact should always redirect to +971 553723617.
Agent Arena authentication should be replaced by a simple Agent Code gate (code: 050702) to access add/edit listing features.

Google Search Console verification file provided: serve /googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.html at site root with content exactly: "google-site-verification: googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.html" (ensure SPA routing does not intercept).

Extend property/listing schema to include furnishingStatus (Furnished/Semi-Furnished/Unfurnished), washrooms (number), and permitNumber (string) and persist these fields in Agent Arena backend + expose in public queries.
WhatsApp contact deep-link should prefill a message that includes the listing title (still always targeting +971 553723617).
Location/building suggestions should be powered by Google Places Autocomplete API (restricted to UAE/Dubai as appropriate); Google does not provide a downloadable full list of Dubai buildings.
Do not use Google Places Autocomplete due to API/billing cost; implement location/building autocomplete suggestions based on locations/titles already present in stored listings.
Public search location autocomplete suggestions must be derived ONLY from existing stored property.location values (do not include property.title in recommendations).
known_issues: Agent Arena backend: agents are currently unable to sign up and/or log in (authentication flow failing).
WhatsApp contact CTA: prefilled WhatsApp message is not including the listing property link/details when a client requests more information (agent is not receiving the listing link in the message).
Agent Arena: adding/creating properties is showing an error (property creation failing).
Public search location autocomplete: suggestions are not showing in the UI and the backend endpoint/query is not returning location suggestions (autocomplete appears broken).
Agent Arena: editing/updating existing properties is failing (error shown when trying to edit a property).

existing_features.title: Create the public frontend for OfficerRentDubai.com with a listings search section that includes: (1) a location text search bar, (2) a commercial type filter with exactly two options: Office and Retail, (3) an Area (SQFT) filter, (4) a Price filter, and (5) a Search action/button that applies the entered filters to the listings results.

Implement property listings browsing on the public frontend: display a results list/grid of properties and allow users to click a listing to open a dedicated listing details view/page showing full property details and photos.
Add a "Contact the agent" button on the listing details view that opens WhatsApp chat to the fixed number +971 553723617.

Implement Agent Arena authentication and access control for agent management features: provide login and signup capability for the agent area, and restrict property creation/editing/deletion to authenticated agents only.

Build the Agent Arena backend capabilities and corresponding frontend UI to add and manage properties, including capturing property details (at minimum: title, location, type: Office/Retail, area sqft, price, description) and uploading multiple photos per property.

Add one coherent, non-blue/non-purple visual theme for the entire app (public portal + Agent Arena) including consistent typography, color palette, spacing, and components styling appropriate for a premium commercial real-estate portal.
Add generated static image assets (logo and minimal UI illustrations/icons) and render them in the frontend from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve generated images through the backend).

Update the Agent Arena frontend flow to handle the backend’s “new user / no profile yet” state without getting stuck on loading or failing silently, and display a clear English error message when login/profile loading fails.

Replace the Agent Arena entry flow at route "/agent" to use an "Agent Code" gate instead of Internet Identity login/signup: show a single input for the agent code and a submit button; when the correct code "050702" is entered, persist the authorized state locally (e.g., localStorage) and navigate to "/agent/dashboard". All user-facing text must be in English.

Update route protection for all Agent Arena pages ("/agent/dashboard", "/agent/properties", "/agent/properties/new", "/agent/properties/edit/:id") to authorize access based on the locally-stored Agent Code authorization state (not Internet Identity identity/role). If unauthorized, show an "Access Denied" screen with a button/link back to "/agent".

Change the Agent Dashboard logout behavior to log out of the Agent Code session (clear the locally-stored authorization state and any related cached agent data) and then return the user to the Agent Arena entry page.

Update the frontend data layer so that create/update/delete property mutations always send the agent code to the backend, and display a clear English error message when the backend rejects an operation due to an invalid/missing agent code.

Support Google Search Console HTML file verification by serving a provided verification HTML file at the website root (e.g., https://officerentdubai.com/<verification-file>.html) as a static asset, without being intercepted by SPA routing.

Add the Google Search Console HTML verification file at the website root by creating a static file named exactly "googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.html" under the frontend public static assets, with the file contents exactly: "google-site-verification: googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.html".
Remove or neutralize the existing placeholder verification file (frontend/public/google-site-verification.html) so it no longer presents placeholder/instructional content in production.

Add a React Query hook to fetch location/building autocomplete suggestions from the backend as the user types, using a debounced input value and only querying when the input has non-whitespace content.

Update the public listings search Location input (in the existing PropertySearchBar) to display an autocomplete/typeahead dropdown while the user types. The dropdown must be selectable with mouse and keyboard, and selecting a suggestion must populate the Location input with that suggestion in plain English UI behavior.

Update the Agent Arena property create/edit form to allow agents to input Permit Number, select Furnishing Status (Furnished / Semi-Furnished / Unfurnished), and enter Washrooms (number), and ensure these values are sent in create/update mutations to the backend.
Display Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms on the public frontend listings UI, including the listing card and the listing details page, using clear English labels.
Add a public search filter for Furnishing Status to the existing PropertySearchBar and make search results respect this filter when applied.

Update the public listing details page WhatsApp CTA so that when a user clicks "Contact Agent on WhatsApp", the prefilled WhatsApp message includes both (a) the property title and (b) the full URL link to the specific property listing details page the user is viewing, so the agent receives the listing link in WhatsApp.

Ensure the ContactAgentButton component supports constructing/including the listing URL in the WhatsApp message (e.g., by accepting a listing id and/or an explicit listing URL from the Listing Details page) and keeps all user-facing text in English.

Update the frontend data layer for property mutations to always send the Agent Code to the backend for create/update/delete property operations, and surface clear English error messages when the backend rejects a mutation due to a missing/invalid Agent Code.

Improve Agent Arena property submission error diagnostics so that, when property creation fails, the UI logs and displays a more specific English error message derived from the backend error (while still handling generic failures gracefully).

Add Google Places Autocomplete API support to provide live location/building name suggestions for the public search Location input, restricted to UAE (components=country:AE) and biased toward Dubai, using the user’s typed input.

Introduce a configurable Google Places API key for the frontend (do not hardcode secrets in source). If the key is missing at runtime/build time, show a clear English fallback behavior and avoid making failing requests.

Keep (or add) a backend-provided autocomplete fallback using the existing `getAutocompleteSuggestions(input, maxResults)` method so the public search location typeahead can still work when Google is unavailable, and ensure the frontend can switch between Google-based suggestions and backend-based suggestions safely.
Fix the backend autocomplete fallback call so the frontend successfully receives suggestions from the Motoko canister when Google Places is not configured or not ready.
Improve the Location autocomplete UX diagnostics in the public search bar so users are not left with a confusing empty dropdown/state when suggestions fail to load.

Update the public search Location autocomplete to recommend locations/building names only from existing property listings (stored properties), and do not call Google Places Autocomplete so the app does not incur Google API charges.
Update the public listings search Location autocomplete recommendations so that suggestions display and return only property location values (do not include or match against property titles).

Ensure the Agent Arena UI shows a clear English error message when property creation or editing fails, surfacing the backend’s returned reason (especially invalid agent code) instead of only a generic failure message.

new_feature_requests.summary: Frontend: listings search with location bar, commercial type selector (office/retail), area (sqft) filter, price filter, and search action to run filters
Frontend: listing details page when a user clicks a listing, showing full property details and photos
Frontend: "Contact the agent" button that redirects to WhatsApp chat with +971 553723617
Backend "Agent Arena": add/manage property listings including property details and photo uploads

Create the backend canister (single Motoko actor) named/used by the frontend as “Agent Arena” that stores property listings and supports querying listings and listing details with filtering by location text, property type (Office/Retail), area (sqft), and price.
Align backend access control checks with the intended roles: property creation/editing/deletion must be restricted to authenticated agents, while public listing queries must remain public.
Replace Agent Arena login/signup with an "Agent Code" access gate: prompt for agent code (050702) and only allow backend add/edit listing features when the correct code is entered.

Enforce the Agent Code on the backend for all listing management operations: property creation, property update, and property deletion must require the correct agent code "050702"; public listing queries must remain publicly accessible without any agent code.
Add Google Search Console HTML file verification support (serve a provided verification HTML file at the site root for domain ownership verification).
Frontend: add location search autocomplete/typeahead that recommends building names and locations while the user types in the location bar
Frontend: add Furnishing Status filter with options Furnished / Semi-Furnished / Unfurnished in public listings search
Listings data + UI: add Washroom count field; allow agents to enter it and display it on listing cards and listing details
WhatsApp CTA: include the listing title in the prefilled WhatsApp message when a user contacts the agent
Listings data + UI: add Permit Number field; allow agents to enter it and display it on the public frontend listing (card/details as appropriate)

Extend the backend Property model and create/update params to store (a) permit number, (b) furnishing status with all options (Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished), and (c) number of washrooms; ensure these fields are returned by all public property query methods and by getPropertyById.

Update backend property management methods so that creating, updating, and deleting properties are authorized by a required Agent Code value "050702" (not by Internet Identity admin permissions), while keeping all public property browsing queries publicly accessible.
Fix backend property ID generation so newly created properties do not overwrite each other, ensuring backend-stored autocomplete suggestions can grow as properties are added.

Update public search location autocomplete so recommendations include ONLY stored property.location values (no property.title/building-name suggestions); keep deduped, case-insensitive matching, and maxResults limit

Fix backend authorization for property create/update/delete so Agent Arena can add and edit properties successfully using only the Agent Code ("050702"), without requiring Internet Identity authentication.
